exact_statement: From admitted spherical metric compute Christoffel and all independent coordinate Riemann and Einstein components. Reduce radial differential jets using the three TOV ODEs and their differentiated consequences, without assuming Einstein or curvature targets. Verify G_hat_ab+Lambda eta_ab=diag(kappa epsilon,kappa alpha epsilon,kappa alpha epsilon,kappa alpha epsilon); all off-diagonal components vanish. This is a conditional finite jet identity; no existence assertion.

At r0,m0=mu r0^3,nu0=0,epsilon0,p0=alpha epsilon0, verify covariant orthonormal R0101=kappa(epsilon0+p0)/2-2mu-Lambda/3, R0202=R0303=B, R1212=R1313=kappa epsilon0/2-mu+Lambda/3, R2323=C, all independent mixed components zero. Derive U=c e0 rates from covariant derivative: |A|=c^2|B|r0/sqrt(1-Cr0^2), rest expansion/shear/vorticity zero. Under Lambda=0,mu=kappa epsilon0/6 verify all Weyl tensor components vanish at the event and (nabla_e1 Weyl)(e0,e1,e0,e1) is nonzero. Covariant derivative must be derived before matched specialization; no derivative target answer admitted.

From admitted fixed action and metric derive stress by metric variation and scalar current by Euler-Lagrange variation. Verify T_ab=P_X psi_a psi_b+P g_ab and J^a=P_X g^(ab)psi_b; psi=q x0 gives divergence J=0. Identify epsilon=2X P_X-P=(2s-1)P, p=P=alpha epsilon, and action derivative ratio cs^2/c^2=alpha with positive denominator. Verify matched normalization gives action stress epsilon0,p0 and agrees with the C01 matched source; derive radial action stress conservation and finite matched TOV derivative-jet agreement using fixed Pstar,q. Identity with a smooth TOV solution on a whole interval requires separate analytic uniqueness and remains HOLD. Reuse reviewed scalar calculus as exact accepted sublemma, without assuming stress/current conclusion.

Derive |A|(y)=(c^2|B|/sqrt(C))*y/sqrt(1-y^2) from the C02 acceleration target and r0=y/sqrt(C). For fixed c,kappa,alpha,epsilon0,p0,Pstar,q,mu,Lambda with admitted conditions,0<y<1, prove algebraic positive finite value and limit +infinity as y tends to1 from below. m0=mu r0^3,nu0=0 by each germ. No F0=0,alpha=0,r0=0 member; existence/distinct-germ interpretation remains analytic HOLD.
